# ci-local contract

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-contract-docs.js from packages/development/toolchain/categories/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Contract version: `1.0`

The `ci-local` category defines 2 capabilities: 1 required and 1 optional. An adapter implementing this category must provide every required capability; a command that needs an optional capability the resolved adapter lacks uses the capability's fallback when one is named.

## Capabilities

| Capability | Required | Side effect | Inputs | Outputs | Fallback | Added in minor | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ci-local.run-workflow` | required | no | `workflow` | `status`, `logs` | - | - | Run a repository's CI workflow(s) locally. |
| `ci-local.list-jobs` | optional | no | `workflow` | `jobs` | - | - | List the jobs defined by the repository's local CI workflow(s), without running them. |

## Shipped backends and coverage

One column per shipped backend. `native` = the backend answers the capability itself; `fallback` = the capability is answered by the fallback named in the contract (a builtin analyzer such as work-graph-links-fallback, or a documented degraded path), not by the backend itself; `unavailable` = neither.

| Capability | act |
| --- | --- |
| `ci-local.run-workflow` | native |
| `ci-local.list-jobs` | native |

## Details

### ci-local.run-workflow

Run a repository's CI workflow(s) locally.

- Status: required
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `workflow`
- Outputs: `status`, `logs`
- Fallback: none

### ci-local.list-jobs

List the jobs defined by the repository's local CI workflow(s), without running them.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `workflow`
- Outputs: `jobs`
- Fallback: none
